gaps.lead: She hates it when people interrupt her.
Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: Although the traffic was heavy, we reached the airport in time.
gaps.sentence: We reached the airport in time ___ traffic.
gaps.explanation: 'Although the traffic was heavy' becomes 'despite the heavy traffic' — despite + noun phrase.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: If the government had acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.sentence: ___ acted sooner, the crisis could have been avoided.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts auxiliary and subject: Had the government acted sooner…

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees himself.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who…' identifies the agent with a relative clause.
